content: As a software developer maintaining the GitHub repository lowRISC_ibex_pr1872, you are responsible for analyzing a submitted issue and identifying the exact location in the repository where the issue occurs.

Here is the issue description:
# insn_trigger_exception coverpoint does not work
The test riscv_debug_triggers_test added in #1801 generates stimulus to hit [this coverpoint](https://github.com/lowRISC/ibex/blob/ce536ae47677e952de02b7421e1b78efb5761ab2/dv/uvm/core_ibex/fcov/core_ibex_fcov_if.sv#L502), but it does not trigger.
```verilog
// > core_ibex_fcov_if.sv
// L502
DV_FCOV_EXPR_SEEN(insn_trigger_exception, instr_id_matches_trigger_q &&
id_stage_i.controller_i.fcov_pipe_flush)
```
REPRO
```
// Checkout https://github.com/lowRISC/ibex/pull/1801
make TEST=riscv_debug_triggers_test ITERATIONS=1 SEED=14664 COV=1 -j12 -ik
// The instruction/event that should trigger this coverpoint can be seen retiring at t = 1010124 ns
```

I suspect that the coverpoint is never actually “seen” because it was never hooked up end‐to‐end in the FCOV interface and environment – both in the covergroup (pkg) and in the env itself. To fix this we’ll need to:

1. Adjust the coverpoint expression/path in core_ibex_fcov_if.sv  
2. Ensure the new `insn_trigger_exception` coverpoint is declared and enumerated in core_ibex_fcov_pkg.sv  
3. Wire the FCOV interface into the environment package in core_ibex_env_pkg.sv  
4. Hook up the FCOV interface in the environment itself in core_ibex_env.sv  

```  
dv/uvm/core_ibex/fcov/core_ibex_fcov_if.sv  
dv/uvm/core_ibex/fcov/core_ibex_fcov_pkg.sv  
dv/uvm/core_ibex/core_ibex_env_pkg.sv  
dv/uvm/core_ibex/core_ibex_env.sv  
```
